There has been a bit of discussion on the hopes of a Voat Minecraft server, and after many people saying that they could do it and many suggestions for the proposed server I've decided it will be more productive to ask you guys for your input.

I'd like people to post ideas and suggestions here on what they'd like to see in an unofficial Voat server so we can piece together what the majority wants to see. Personally I think it would be great fun playing MC with fellow Voaters on a server made for Voaters.

I've had many years experience running semi-vanilla survival servers but I've also had experience with mini-games. If the general consensus is for semi-vanilla survival (that is, basic survival with land protection, economy, etc) then I'd be happy to make it and rent a reliable host. For a ddos protected 2 GB RAM server it would cost around $20 USD per month to run, and being a uni student my broke ass can't pay for much so I may or may not need help with that, we'll just see how it goes.

Running survival servers is a bit of a passion of mine and you can all be assured that I will pay proper attention to it. So what are your thoughts? Let me hear them!
